body.message:
Hi Elspeth,

Apologies for the delay in getting back to you.

We were awaiting confirmation from the management team, which is why our response took longer than expected.

Please note that, following a management review, the rates have been revised. Unfortunately, as a result, we are unable to offer an extension at the same rate as your current stay.

We appreciate your understanding and are happy to discuss the available extension options with you.
